color.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-bg
color.notes: Owns desktop sidebar and shared tray surface; do not replace with target-store literals.

color.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-text
color.value: runtime merchant value; defaults to global primary text
color.notes: Primary summary copy and inherited icon color.

color.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-border-color
color.notes: Used where the preset surface contract includes a border.

color.name: --bundle-sidebar-button-bg / --bundle-sidebar-button-text
color.value: runtime merchant values inherited from sidebar or global primary button settings
color.notes: Persistent primary action and disclosure badge must preserve contrast under merchant configuration.

color.name: --bundle-focus-outline-color
color.value: runtime merchant value; defaults to global primary button
color.notes: If merchant color fails contrast against a given surface, use existing contrast-safe focus fallback logic rather than hiding the outline.

typography.name: --bundle-summary-title-font-size
typography.notes: Title remains content-driven and wraps; no viewport-specific font copy.

typography.name: --bundle-summary-subtitle-font-size
typography.notes: Subtitle uses a readable 1.5 line-height and wraps long localization.

typography.name: summary-price-numeric-alignment
typography.notes: Improves stable total alignment without changing the merchant font family.

spacing.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-padding
spacing.notes: Evidence confirms 20px across target desktop presets; preserve merchant override and use as shell inset.

spacing.name: --bundle-summary-section-spacing
spacing.notes: Default shared vertical rhythm between semantic regions.

spacing.name: --bundle-summary-row-gap
spacing.notes: Shared row/slot spacing; preset CSS may vary density only through a named alias.

spacing.name: --fpb-mobile-summary-inset
spacing.notes: Creates an inset tray at 320px through tablet portrait without fixed screenshot widths.

size.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-width
size.notes: Treat as a preferred standard width inside responsive constraints, not an unconditional fixed track.

size.name: --bundle-sidebar-products-max-height
size.notes: Clamp against available dynamic viewport/container space so totals and actions remain reachable.

size.name: --bundle-summary-thumbnail-size
size.notes: Square summary media primitive; may shrink through a narrow-width clamp, never stretch.

size.name: --bundle-control-hit-target
size.notes: 44px minimum target for disclosure, clear, remove, box, Back, Next, and cart controls.

size.name: --fpb-mobile-summary-expanded-max-block-size
size.notes: Caps expanded tray while leaving the page non-modal and the persistent action reachable.

radius.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-radius
radius.notes: Reference measurement confirms 10px shell radius; Classic may remain visually borderless while retaining clipping radius.

radius.name: --bundle-sidebar-button-radius
radius.value: runtime merchant values inherited from configured footer/action radius
radius.notes: Applies to primary action without overriding merchant corner style.

border.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-border-width
border.notes: Standard and Horizontal surface identity may show it; Classic remains borderless.

shadow.name: --bundle-sidebar-card-shadow
shadow.value: none unless existing merchant/preset configuration supplies a shadow
shadow.notes: Direction A does not introduce a new floating-card shadow.

z_index.name: --bundle-mobile-summary-z-index
z_index.notes: Must remain below product/confirmation dialogs and above ordinary page content.

motion.name: --fpb-mobile-summary-disclosure-duration
motion.owner: shared mobile summary CSS and mobile-summary-methods.js
motion.notes: One connected tray/caret transition; keeps expansion consistent across presets.

motion.name: --fpb-mobile-summary-disclosure-easing
motion.notes: Both directions use the same reversible easing.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.notes: All final state and accessibility attributes update synchronously.

breakpoint.name: --fpb-summary-sidebar-min-container-width
breakpoint.notes: RD-001: sidebar at 1024px and above; tray below, based on measured widget-container width.

component_alias.name: fpb-summary-desktop-track-by-preset
component_alias.value: preserve current measured preset relationships: Standard narrow bordered, Classic airier borderless, Compact wide, Horizontal intermediate bordered
component_alias.notes: Do not replace all desktop tracks with one fixed width; at 1440x900 target boundaries must remain close to approved baselines unless content forces growth.

component_alias.name: fpb-summary-mobile-tray-track
component_alias.notes: Same geometry for Standard, Classic, Compact, and Horizontal below RD-001.

tolerances.assertion: major desktop sidebar and mobile tray boundaries
tolerances.failure: Any larger unexplained delta or dimension mismatch

tolerances.budget: exact at measured container widths 1023, 1024, and 1025
tolerances.failure: Both surfaces, neither surface, wrong accessibility exposure, or state loss
Any page-level overflow, clipped focus indicator, or hidden primary action

tolerances.budget: no unapproved shift outside summary expansion region
tolerances.failure: Catalog/page jump, fixed inline height after animation, or action displacement
Unexpected truncation, overlap, or semantic copy hidden at required fixtures
